summary: Centrus Energy Corp. filed an 8-K announcing a definitive contract with X-energy to supply low-enriched uranium and high-assay low-enriched uranium for advanced reactors, with deliveries beginning in 2030. The agreement includes prepayments from X-energy to support Centrus's domestic enrichment capacity program, building on Centrus's $3 billion LEU and HALEU backlog ($2.4 billion definitized) and a $900 million DOE enrichment award. This is a routine commercial supply contract, not a special-situation transaction. The filing reports ordinary business activity under Item 8.01. No M&A, restructuring, tender offer, or similar corporate event is involved, so no special-situation category applies. Watch for future capacity build-out milestones and regulatory developments.
